messages:
Nina Park: Quick follow-up from the RFC: proposing a "soft-reserve" API: reserve(id, mode=\"ephemeral\"|\"sticky\", ttl_ms=60000) + release(id). Soft-reserve biases evictor but can be preempted under pressure. Thoughts?

Tomás Ruiz: Simpler for SDKs. Concern: how do callers learn about preemption? Need an eviction-notify event with reason field.

Ellen Wu: Ran small perf runs replacing LeaseToken with soft-reserve:
```
workload: mixed-concurrent
median: +4%
p95: +9%
cost/unit: -12%
```
Tails grow a bit but cost wins.

Nina Park: Plan: default ephemeral, sticky opt-in. Disable sticky in initial canary. Add demote policy: demote_after_ms=120000 and per-tenant frag_quota.

Tomás Ruiz: Add metrics: tenant_frag_score, soft_reserve_count, preemptions/sec. Alert when frag_score>0.75 and preemptions>5/s.

Ellen Wu: Also adding an incremental coalesce pass (rate-limited) to reduce fragmentation; cheap and async.

infra-bot: feature flag memory.soft_reserve created. Canary rollout: group=canary-1 start=Thu 02:00 UTC. Dashboards: /d/memory/soft-reserve (owner: @Nina).

Nina Park: Action items: Ellen land coalesce, Tomás add alerts + simulate mixed traces, I'll write RFC follow-up with API examples and rollout gates. Ping here when done.

Tomás Ruiz: Will run sims with Q4_replay + synthetic heavy-tail this afternoon.

Ellen Wu: noted, pushing coalesce branch now.

infra-bot: canary created (id: canary-2026-05-14-03).
